The '''F-31 drive engine''' was a [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]] produced by [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]]<ref name="FF26" /> sometime in pre-[[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> It was capable of a maximum atmospheric speed of 1,000 [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|kph]], and a sublight speed of 70 [[Megalight|MGLTs]]. Owned by the infamous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]],<ref name="FF26" /> it was used on his [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft]], [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']].<ref name="TechPlate">[["Slave 1" TechPlate]]</ref> Along with the four [[XF-16 power generator]]s it took up two thirds of the mass<ref name="FF26" /> of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian's]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]].<ref name="Uncivilized">{{SW|url=news/so-uncivilized-great-gunslingers-in-star-wars-part-1|series=So Uncivilized: Great Gunslingers in Star Wars|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>
